{{Quote|The prisoners are taking out their vengeance on the Republic. The mynocks are coming home to roost, and we get front row seats.|Captain Habbaz|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Habbaz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] Captain Habbaz recruited Imperial forces to wipe out a group of [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoners in the [[High Security Section]] who had begun manufacturing weapons and targeting Imperials.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Habbaz appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he provides Imperial players with the mission "Gearing Up."<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
